title: Auto-mode block result has a doubled period: '…soft-blocked operation.. Do not try…'
observed: kiln defect (copy). The bash block shows '→ auto mode blocked this action: This pipes a downloaded script straight into a shell (curl | sh), which runs untrusted code in one step and is a soft-blocked operation.. Do not try to reach the same result another way.' The classifier's reason ends with '.' and kiln appends '. '.
expected: Trim a trailing period from the reason before appending.
